summary: The pushed head ddd38ba passes its merge step. The commit chain is right, the merged bytes equal the reviewed bytes, and the second counted call (merge-2.log) meets the pass bar on every item. The gate passes, the built check reads 25 of 25, and the size is 967 of 1,050. C1 to C8 of my merge-stop ruling are met, except C7: the pre-flight's written commands need fixing before they run. The P0 re-judge (brief section 7) may run now, as written. The pre-flight may not run as written. Its judge call `--only PM-0001-17` removes PM-0001-2 from the judged marks file. -17's L1 P2 part then fails its own validity rule (pre:PM-0001-2: "not in marks.json"), and the judge reads no check on an invalid run. The pre-flight would therefore give no reading of either figure, every time. That error is in my own ruling's wording, and the main session copied it faithfully. The fix is `--only PM-0001-2,PM-0001-17`, plus three small hardenings (below). Two record fixes go into the report: the first call's whole test output no longer exists on disk, and one sentence of my earlier ruling about npt-lab and npt-net was too strong. I ran nothing: no cargo, no gate, no run. Every number here is read from the logs, from git and from the code.

findings.where: .checkpoints/netcode-proof-test/c62h-bound-build.md:475 (pre-flight step 5); spikes/netcode-proof/crates/judge/src/main.rs:85-93; crates/judge/src/eval.rs:958-962, :1186-1188, :1724-1737; marks.json PM-0001-17 part 'L1 P2' validity ["pre:PM-0001-2"]
findings.what: The pre-flight's judge call `--only PM-0001-17` can never read either figure. --only keeps only PM-0001-17 in the marks file the judge uses (main.rs:92), and the precondition lookup uses that same file (ctx.marks). -17's L1 P2 part's rule pre:PM-0001-2 therefore pushes 'pre:PM-0001-2: not in marks.json' as an invalid reason, and judge_run returns before it evaluates any check (eval.rs:1186-1188). The pre-flight would be 'not informative' every time, which defeats its purpose: catching a reader surprise before the 29-minute P2 set. Nothing would give a wrong PASS: the ruling's fallback runs the set as planned. The error is in my own ruling's text ('--only PM-0001-17'), which the main session copied faithfully. The runner passes --only listedOf(P2) = PM-0001-2,PM-0001-17,PM-0001-57 (c-u4r-runs.mjs:305, :569), so the sets are not affected.
findings.fix: In step 5, use `--only PM-0001-2,PM-0001-17` (the run's header list). The judge then evaluates PM-0001-2's SS-runs checks as the precondition, and -17's checks on a valid run. Read -17's L1 P2 part: runs[0].checks for snap_lost_unexplained_count and snap_whole_despite_link_loss_count. The part reads NOT-RUN ('1 of 3 valid runs') when nothing fails. That is expected and is not a stop.

findings.what: Three gaps in the pre-flight's commands. (a) npt-lab is the binary merge-2 left in the shared target, with no rebuild and no expected hash: merge-2 printed none, and worktrees can rebuild into the shared target. So 'at the pushed head' is assumed, not shown. (b) 'npt-judge sha256 equal to the re-judge's' is stated, but no comparison or stop is written. (c) '--commit <the pushed head, full>' is unclear: by then HEAD is the re-judge's commit. Separately, the 6 s warm-up is the 16-client test's. P2's 48-client load checks (pre:PM-0001-2: 48 connected snapshot-receiving clients on every measured tick, and the others) are proven only at the sets' 10 s warm-up (c-u4r-runs.mjs:118). A client still joining would make the run INVALID with no figure reading.
findings.fix: Rewrite the commands as given in preflight_commands_ruling. Add `cargo build --locked --release -p npt-lab` before the sha256sum (main-run.sh's touch loop makes it rebuild from the main folder's bytes; about 10 s). Check npt-judge's sha256 against p0-rejudge.log's line and marks.json against c1935a5b…, and stop for the advisor on any difference. Pass --commit as the full `git rev-parse HEAD` at the call, after `git diff --quiet ddd38bace3c63050d2087a1acf3a6e74c1d2ecb9 HEAD -- spikes/netcode-proof ':(exclude)spikes/netcode-proof/results'` exits 0. A part verdict of NOT-RUN ('1 of 3 valid runs') with both figures reading 0 and no gap note means proceed. Nothing is committed, and nothing goes under results/.
